description: Unit test for ImmutablePolicyBuilder class, testing policy creation, modification, and validation within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies package.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyBuilderTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the functionality of ImmutablePolicyBuilder, including policy creation, modification, and validation scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new ImmutablePolicyBuilder instance before each test.

methods.name: createEmptyPolicy
methods.description: Tests creating an empty policy and verifies its ID and namespace.

methods.name: tryToSetNullPolicyId
methods.description: Verifies that setting a null PolicyId throws a NullPointerException with the correct message.

methods.name: tryToSetNullPolicyIdCharSequence
methods.description: Verifies that setting an invalid (null) string as ID throws a PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToSetNullPolicyEntry
methods.description: Checks that passing null to set() method on policy entry throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToSetNullPolicyEntries
methods.description: Checks that passing null to setAll() method on policy entries throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: buildPolicyFromScratch
methods.description: Builds a complex policy from scratch with multiple labels, subjects, resources, and permissions, then asserts the expected policy structure.

methods.name: buildPolicyFromScratchWithScopedLabel
methods.description: Tests building a policy with scoped labels, verifying multiple labels and resource permissions.

methods.name: buildPolicyFromExistingPolicy
methods.description: Creates a new policy based on an existing one, modifying labels, subjects, and resources, and verifying correctness.

methods.name: replaceExistingPolicyEntry
methods.description: Replaces a policy entry in an existing policy and verifies the updated attributes.

methods.name: buildPolicyWithoutPolicyId
methods.description: Creates a policy without setting a PolicyId, checking that the entity ID is empty.
